newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal 1997 revs to help meet target.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal 1997 revs to help meet target.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc said Thursday it foresaw "top-line growth" led by new products and global expansion helping the company meet its goal of growing 13 percent to 17 percent in earnings in 1997.
The company said it also expected "strong cash flow and balance sheet" to give it the resources it needed to quicken sales through "strategic" acquisitions.
Fourth-quarter earnings totalled $0.96 a share against $0.83 a year ago.
Net sales for the same period reached $3.5 billion, compared to $3.8 billion the previous year.
"With passenger miles and the number of flights continuing to rise, we expect double-digit Aerospace sales growth to continue in 1997," it said, referring to one of its divisions.
Aerospace had sales totalling $1.6 billion in the fourth quarter, 12 percent more than the $1.4 billion during the same period last year.
